messages:
zoe (support): FYI customer reporting exported CSVs from Console are coming back with only headers when they include a segmentation on 'region' and a >30d range. INC-7892.
zoe (support): jill says download is 0 bytes sometimes, other times header-only. Happens in Chrome + curl.
jill (customer): reproducer: Console -> Analytics -> user_events -> segment by region -> last 60 days -> Export CSV. Presigned link downloads 200 OK but file is 53 bytes (headers only).
mike (eng-runtime): can you paste the export job id from the UI (hover over download row)?
jill (customer): job id: export_20260304_9842. Also tried API exports: POST /api/exports with same filters -> job created, job completes but payload empty.
zoe (support): tried to repro in prod with similar query (last 60d + region). saw header-only on one run. attaching job id I saw: export_20260304_9912.
sam (sre): quick checks: presigned URL returns 200 and content-length 53. S3 object size is 53. So the upload completed with header-only. Not a client truncation.
mike (eng-runtime): any errors in export-worker? Can you grab logs for job id export_20260304_9912 (container, timestamp range)?
sam (sre): tail from worker node:
```
2026-03-04T15:22:31Z export_worker[pid=223] INFO starting export job export_20260304_9912
2026-03-04T15:22:41Z export_worker[pid=223] WARN metrics-service timeout waiting for aggregated metrics (10s)
2026-03-04T15:22:42Z export_worker[pid=223] INFO falling back to stream-by-row mode
2026-03-04T15:22:44Z export_worker[pid=223] ERROR serialization: index out of range while writing row buffer
2026-03-04T15:22:44Z export_worker[pid=223] INFO upload to s3 complete size=53
```
mike (eng-runtime): serialization index error looks suspicious. Fallback path should still stream rows. Looks like when aggregation times out and fallback path is used with segmentation we hit an edge-case that yields zero rows.
zoe (support): customer says this started after the late-night rollout two days ago. Could be related.
mike (eng-runtime): can someone try a quick repro with a small dataset and force metrics-service timeout? I can push a patch if we confirm.
sam (sre): repro steps for us: set metrics-service env DEBUG_TIMEOUT=1 to force timeout, run same export query. I ran it locally and reproduced header-only.
mike (eng-runtime): thanks, I see the bug: fallback path assumes aggregated column map exists; when aggregation fails it uses an empty column vector and row serialization loops skip rows. Hotfix incoming.
mike (eng-runtime): rolling out a patch that ensures row serializer handles empty aggregates and retries aggregation once. Will roll to prod in canary now.
support-bot: Incident INC-7892 created, priority P2, assigned to eng-runtime.
joel (notified): FYI will monitor export errors and alerting thresholds.
zoe (support): told customer workaround: reduce date range to 30 days or remove segmentation until patch applied. Customer accepted workaround.
mike (eng-runtime): patch deployed to canary at 2026-03-05T03:10Z. Can someone validate export_20260304_9912-like query?
sam (sre): re-ran export with same filters against canary - CSV now contains rows. S3 object size ~1.2MB.
jill (customer): confirmed for me too — downloaded full CSV after ~10m. Thanks!
zoe (support): closing loop with customer and attaching root cause: fallback serializer bug when metrics aggregation times out -> header-only CSV. Workaround + fix noted.
mike (eng-runtime): will backport to stable and schedule postmortem doc.
support-bot: INC-7892 status -> resolved.
